packageRules.description: Node.js and Playwright need a CI image rebuild: keep them out of the all-minor-patch batch
Test apps resolve SDK packages to local package.tgz builds, and some (e.g. browser-debugger) are not published on npm
The vanilla app's typescript is replaced by each check of scripts/check-typescript-compatibility.ts, so its committed version doesn't matter
@angular/core-15 is an alias kept on v15 to test the oldest supported Angular version
react-router-dom-6 is an alias kept on v6 to test the v6 integration
vue-router-4 and nuxt-3 are aliases kept on their major to test the Vue Router v4 and Nuxt 3 integrations
The Node 20 Dockerfile stage installs the browsers of the Playwright version pinned for old-browser e2e jobs
webpack 5.112.0-5.112.2 moved internal files that @module-federation/enhanced imports (https://github.com/webpack/webpack/issues/22932)
The root rolldown resolution must stay in the range vite requires (vite 8.3 depends on rolldown ~1.2): a mismatch corrupts the developer extension build. Widen it when vite moves to a newer rolldown
